<b>Frayed Rosary Strings</b> are [[Items_(Silksong)#Consumables|consumable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Can be used from the inventory to gain {{R|30}}.

Strung Rosaries are not dropped upon death.

== How to Acquire ==
There are 19 Frayed Rosary Strings that can be obtained, found across [[Pharloom]] at glowing item spots.
